source_notes.label: Proposed phase transfer, reduction and recovery
source_notes.summary: The authors describe a liquid ethanol/linoleic-acid phase, solid sodium linoleate and a water/ethanol phase containing Ag ions. They propose Ag-ion exchange into silver linoleate, reduction by ethanol at interfaces, outward-facing alkyl chains and gravity-assisted phase separation. These are the paper’s mechanism interpretation; silver linoleate, ligand coverage and phase compositions were not directly measured.
source_locators: Supplied PDF p. 2, hydrothermal preparation and mechanism

source_notes.label: Particle cores and assembled monolayers are distinct
source_notes.summary: The TEM specimen shows round, smooth Ag particles, a reported diameter of 5.0 ± 0.3 nm and ordered arrays on a carbon-film/Cu support. The ± statistic is unspecified. The authors interpret the smooth packing as diffusion outpacing arrival during grid drying; it does not establish a measured diffusion coefficient or a separate synthesis.
source_locators: Supplied PDF pp. 2–3, TEM method, Figure 1 and packing discussion

source_notes.label: Surface identity remains unresolved
source_notes.summary: The preparation and Figure 2 discussion describe linoleic-acid passivation, while Figure 1 and the interlinking discussion refer to sodium linoleate tails. Both descriptions are kept as source-proposed context; neither is a measured bound-ligand structure or a resolved identity assignment.
source_locators: Supplied PDF pp. 2–3, Figure 1 caption, passivation and Figure 2 discussion

source_notes.label: Spacing and weak plasmon absorption
source_notes.summary: The source reports a center-separation/particle-diameter ratio D/2r of approximately 1.75. It associates weak plasmon absorption with small particle cores and ordered separation. No absolute interparticle gap, shell thickness, quantitative coupling constant or absorption-peak wavelength is inferred.
source_locators: Supplied PDF pp. 3–4, Figure 3 and D/2r discussion

source_notes.label: PL explanation is a hypothesis
source_notes.summary: The measured 390 nm PL band is obtained with 250 nm excitation on quartz. The authors propose radiative sp-electron/d-hole recombination enhanced by a combination of surface plasmon and an electrostatic mechanism analogous to SERS. This source does not supply its own Raman measurement, absolute PL quantum yield or time-resolved mechanism test.
source_locators: Supplied PDF pp. 3–4, optical methods and mechanism

source_notes.label: Cited variations do not become new recipes
source_notes.summary: Temperature control of core size, alternative fatty-acid/sodium-stearate combinations and electronic transitions appear as cited discussion, including an unpublished reference. No separate source-defined charge, temperature series or measured conductivity outcome is supplied here.
source_locators: Supplied PDF p. 3, cited size and ligand variations; p. 4, reference 12

evidence_conflicts: Proposed surface species are described as in situ linoleic acid in the method/Figure 2 discussion, while Figure 1 attributes interlinks to sodium linoleate tails. Both statements retained as source interpretation; molecular surface identity unresolved.
